finalText:
**Root cause is `refresh.js`, not `tokens.js:6`.**

When `auth.internal` returns 400 `invalid_grant`, [refresh.js:15](src/auth/refresh.js:15) returns `undefined` instead of throwing. That `undefined` flows into `decode(token)` at [session.js:8](src/session.js:8), so `token.split('.')` blows up on `undefined`.

`tokens.js:6` is just where it happens to explode, not the bug.

Next: decide whether `refreshToken` should throw on unrecoverable errors instead of returning `undefined`.
